name: listening-map-site
description: Frontend of Listening map: a static page built with esbuild and deployed to GitHub Pages

scripts.build: esbuild assets/js/main=src/main.js assets/css/main=src/main.css index.html assets/favicon.svg assets/apple-touch-icon.png data/*.json --bundle --minify --sourcemap --target=es2020 --outdir=dist --loader:.html=copy --loader:.svg=copy --loader:.png=copy --loader:.json=copy
